press_references.value: BBK and Batelco by Beyon provide exclusive offers to Mortgage Loan customers during the “Innovation in Social Housing” Summit

partnership_announcements.description: Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait (BBK) and Batelco by Beyon have announced a new partnership to provide exclusive smart home and fiber internet offers to mortgage loan customers during the 'Innovation in Social Housing' Summit. The collaboration aims to introduce smart home solutions to homeowners, supporting Bahrain's digital transformation in the housing sector.

press_references.value: BBK-JP Morgan boost cross-border payments in Bahrain

partnership_announcements.description: The collaboration will leverage JP Morgan’s ‘Xpedite Auto’ solution, which uses AI to improve payment processing, reduce transaction times, and optimize costs for international transactions.

about_short_description.short_description: Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait is a financial group offering retail, corporate, treasury, and investment banking.

product.name: Retail Banking
product.description: Provides banking services to individual customers including deposit accounts, loans, and digital banking channels.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Offers working capital facilities, term loans, and syndicated loans to businesses across various industries.

product.name: International Banking
product.description: Delivers banking services through branches and representative offices in multiple countries, supporting global financial transactions.

product.name: Treasury and Investment Services
product.description: Provides financial management, trading, foreign exchange, and investment products to corporate clients.

product.name: Digital Banking Channels
product.description: Enables customers to access banking services via online platforms, mobile apps, and electronic terminals.
